cabinet.name: Le cabinet médical
cabinet.alt: The bright first floor of the doctor's house, a body-and-fitness room with a gym floor on the left and a little indoor pool on the right, painted in ink and gouache: a man in a green tracksuit waves a giant yellow foam hand, a girl stretches her leg on a bench beside an open jar of apricot jam and a curious bee, a sailor rolls his shoulders with a parrot perched on one, a dad lies on a mat while a toy train chugs across his chest, a pelican with a flower puffs out its throat pouch, a giant apple core stretches like a gymnast, a physio gasps at the apple pie by her bare foot, a strongman curls a brass kettlebell, a gnome lifeguard wags his finger from a tall chair, a baker carries a lump of dough on his back, a scruffy dog sits in a heart-shaped pool ring, its red curly hair styled into a big heart with a comb in it, a plump man floats belly-up over a bubbling jet, a swimmer puffs out her cheeks beside a round soufflé on the poolside, a gnu bends down on its front knees to drink at the pool edge, and a giant chess pawn in goggles raises a tiny fist. Six colored doors lead off: blue, yellow and red on the first floor, green, purple and white up the stairs on the balcony; the open glass front door on the far left leads out to the map.

doors.label: La salle du visage
doors.hint: Go through the blue door on the first floor

doors.label: La salle d'attente
doors.hint: Go through the yellow door to the doctor's waiting room

doors.label: Le bureau du docteur
doors.hint: Go through the red door and up the stairs to the doctor's study

doors.label: L'atelier des mains
doors.hint: Climb the stairs to the green door on the balcony

doors.label: La salle des organes
doors.hint: Climb the stairs to the purple door on the balcony

doors.label: Les combles
doors.hint: Climb the stairs to the white door at the top

visage.name: La salle du visage
visage.alt: A cheerful face clinic in the doctor's house, painted in ink and gouache: pale yellow walls, a wooden floor and a round rug in the middle. On the left a robot whose head is built of bright blocks drops its last block in, a grandpa in an armchair cups his ear, a figure skater admires her face in a standing mirror, and a boy peels a potato in one long ribbon of skin. On the right a wooden cuckoo boings out of its clock on a springy neck, a border guard compares a passport photo with a traveler's face nose to nose, a pony neighs so hard that a man's paper hat flies off, and a boy in a pirate hat peers through a spyglass. The purple door on the left leads back to the cabinet; the green door on the right leads to the funny-faces room.

doors.label: Le cabinet médical
doors.hint: Go back through the purple door to the cabinet

doors.label: La salle des grimaces
doors.hint: Go through the green door to the funny-faces room

grimaces.name: La salle des grimaces
grimaces.alt: The funny-faces room next to the face clinic, painted in ink and gouache with mint-green walls and a wooden floor. A zoo keeper in khaki gets a kiss on the cheek from a llama, a potted bush is clipped into a giant smiling mouth, a frog in an examination chair stretches its long tongue to hold a pink shell up to a baby elephant, a toddler in a high chair scrunches up her face, and a lever with a red knob on a jack-in-the-box makes a jester's red lips grin. On a pillar a furry little creature clings to the wall, a boy frowns with a ladybird in his hair, and an attendant points a buzzing shaver at the one hair on a giant egg. A coat stand, a potted plant and a rug fill the right; the wooden door on the left leads back to the face clinic.

doors.label: La salle du visage
doors.hint: Go back through the wooden door to the face clinic

mains.name: L'atelier des mains
mains.alt: A busy attic workshop for hands and heads, painted in ink and gouache: a girl touches the nape of her neck where a raindrop from the skylight has landed, a girl balances a pomegranate on her palm, a girl rubs her ankle beside a toy car, a boy holds an ice pack to his temple, an ostrich carries a bone, a mouse walks a tightrope near the ceiling, Puss in Boots gives a thumbs-up, an old carpenter leans on his elbow beside a dove, a manicurist files a girl's nail, and a sailor boy points his index finger at a model ship. The green door leads back to the cabinet.

doors.label: Le cabinet médical
doors.hint: Go back through the green door to the cabinet

organes.name: La salle des organes
organes.alt: A cheerful lavender anatomy classroom at eye level, painted in ink and gouache. On the left a purple door leads back to the cabinet, beside a coat stand. A little green dragon on a stool breathes warmly and melts a lane through the icicles on a frosted window, and a waiter backs through swinging half-doors balancing a quiche on his raised thigh. A puma takes a huge breath under two pink balloons it has blown up, a stout man plays a tuba with a plush liver toy sitting in its bell, and a mother hippo pats her round tummy while her baby calls for more. On the right a mouse plays a little pipe organ whose pipes are a heart and two lungs, in front of an orange door; a teal door stands beside it.

doors.label: Le cabinet médical
doors.hint: Go back through the purple door to the cabinet

doors.label: Le coin du barbier
doors.hint: Go through the orange door to the barber's corner

doors.label: La salle des os
doors.hint: Go through the teal door to the bones room

barbier.name: Le coin du barbier · Barber's Corner
barbier.alt: A cozy barber's corner with orange and cream walls and a checkered floor, painted in ink and gouache. A barber with comb and scissors trims an old man's enormous curly beard in a green barber's chair, a moose in a blue coat proudly twirls its huge curly mustache, and a mother crocodile opens her huge jaw under a shower to rinse her teeth. A cheerleader with rosy cheeks waves a red pom-pom, a juggler in a striped leotard juts out his chin under an iron ball, and a girl runs off hugging a pink bean-shaped plush kidney. On the right a lavender door leads back to the anatomy classroom, beside a hat stand and a bench.

doors.label: La salle des organes
doors.hint: Back through the lavender door to the anatomy classroom

os.name: La salle des os · Bones Room
os.alt: A pale-teal bones-and-muscles teaching room with a wooden floor, painted in ink and gouache. On the left a lavender door leads back to the anatomy classroom. A vain strongman in a striped leotard flexes his arm and admires a blue vein on it, and a horse flares a nostril to sniff a nectarine held up to it. A little yellow toy crane lowers a dinosaur fossil skull into a glass case of bones, a teaching skeleton in sunglasses and a striped scarf waves hello, a ginger kitten in a striped leotard flexes a tiny muscle, and two mice push a marble bust in a woolly hat onto its pedestal. A cabinet of bone models and a chart stand on the right.

doors.label: La salle des organes
doors.hint: Back through the lavender door to the anatomy classroom

combles.name: Les combles
combles.alt: The wooden attic at the top of the doctor's house, painted in ink and gouache: an old lecturer points with his shirt cuff and gold cufflink showing, a red spiral water slide with a marble whooshing down it, a girl with a long braid tied in a ribbon, a boy sorting red bricks into piles with blank tags, a grandma with her tea and a shy tortoise turning away, a silver tray of soft plush organs, a fairy setting a big diamond in a ring, a lumberjack balancing a toy van along his forearm, an ant in a sun hat hiking along a coiled garden hose, a jigsaw finished by a little man-shaped piece, and a sculptor smoothing a clay bust's cheeks upward. The white door leads back down to the cabinet.

doors.label: Le cabinet médical
doors.hint: Go back through the white door to the cabinet

docteur.name: La salle d'attente
docteur.alt: The doctor's busy, gentle waiting room, painted in ink and gouache: an old explorer by the window shows a pale old scar on his forearm next to a drooping little potted tree, a rosy grandma raises her cup of tea, a young angler hops holding his sore toe, a girl covers a cough while a toucan looks on, a boy pours water from a pitcher over a tiny cut with a Band-Aid ready, a tiger cub sleeps across two chairs, a feverish boy with a thermometer sits in a tub of ice, a sneezing girl in a scarf clutches a hot-water bottle, Dr. Cal finds a hamster asleep in his medical bag, a kind woman doctor listens to a boy's chest while her cat purrs, a goat clutches the top of a step-ladder with spinning eyes, a grumpy green virus puppet hovers by the yellow door, and Sue lifts a sack of potatoes off a large man's back. On the back wall a long examination tray holds a seasick sailor boy, kittens, a giraffe, a mouse, a boy in a blanket and a girl with a star sticker. The yellow door leads back to the cabinet.

doors.label: Le cabinet médical
doors.hint: Go back through the yellow door to the cabinet

zooms.label: le plateau d'examen
zooms.hint: Look closer at the examination tray on the back wall

plateau.name: Le plateau d'examen
plateau.alt: Close-up of the long white examination tray on the waiting-room wall: a seasick sailor boy in a captain's cap pinches his nose, a basket of kittens bursts into sneezes, a giraffe sticks out a sore tongue for the doctor, a little mouse looks something up in a huge blue book, a boy with a cold sits wrapped in a patchwork blanket among crumpled tissues, and a brave little girl shows off the gold star sticker on her sleeve.

bureau.name: Le bureau du docteur
bureau.alt: The doctor's quiet study upstairs, painted in ink and gouache: a tired runner faints onto the sofa while a friend fans her, a blank picture frame hangs on the wall, a blank sheet waits on an easel, a grandpa shows his grandson the star sticker from his vaccination, the doctor's cat creeps along the bookshelf checking for dust, the doctor points at an X-ray of an anteater's long nose while the anteater waits, a nurse smiles at a pigeon in a basket, and Roy in his paper crown judges a soup-cooling contest beside a snowman. The red door leads back down to the cabinet.

doors.label: Le cabinet médical
doors.hint: Go back through the red door to the cabinet
